critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2339-2350 formats + detect are public (no auth) — correct per spec (credit-free).

server.py:2437-2440 approve uses 422 with a joined 'error' severity issue message — good UX for the client to render actionable errors.
server.py:2408-2417 PUT accepts only a whitelisted set of editable fields + reruns validate_extraction on the merged doc — safe design, prevents arbitrary field injection.
strategy_import.build_draft correctly wires conversion.confidence_score -> conversion_confidence at the doc top-level and marks imported=True + status='draft'.
strategy_import.to_library_doc drops raw_source before inserting into strategy_library — good (keeps library docs light).
server.py:2442-2443 collision fallback appends 4-char uuid on id conflict — prevents unique-index style errors and preserves human-readable prefix.
server.py:2447 lib_doc.pop('_id', None) guards against MongoDB _id leak in response — good.
ImportStrategyModal.jsx is inside components/ but ~340+ lines — approaching the 700-line project split threshold; still fine, but review-step and edit-step could be extracted.
